official.deadline_central_display: No separate scholarship deadline is published; awards run on a rolling basis inside the master's admission cycle
official.deadline_note: Nova SBE publishes no standalone scholarship deadline. For the 2026/27 cycle the general application window ran 13/11/2025 to 30/04/2026 for all master's programmes except IMF, IMM, CEMS MIM and Double Degrees, and 13/11/2025 to 23/03/2026 for IMF, IMM, CEMS MIM, Double Degrees and Workstreams; the Spring Intake 2027 (Master's in Management only, classes from February 2027) also closed on 30/04/2026. Partner-funded awards on the same official page published a window of 13 November 2025 to 23 March 2026, Fall Intake only. Scholarship results are shared until the enrolment fee (P1) payment deadline.
official.application_cycle: Master's admission cycle 2026/27 (Fall intake; Spring 2027 intake only for the Master's in Management)
official.status_note: The official admission page states 'Master's Programs 2026/27: Applications are closed.' Rounds 1-5 ran from 13/11/2025 to 30/04/2026, with Round 5 covering regular master's programmes only. Dates for the 2027/28 cycle are not yet published.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published as a percentage of tuition: Nova SBE Merit Scholarship 20% or 50%; Social Mobility Scholarship 20%, 50% or 100%; Continuity Scholarship 50% or 100%; Women in Finance Scholarship 20% or 50%; NOVAFRICA Scholarship 100%, 50% or 20%; and the partner-funded awards (Accenture, Andre Sousa Bessa, Antonio Serrenho, Banco Primus, Deloitte, Explorer Excellence, KPMG, McKinsey First Generation, McKinsey Women in Leadership, NOS, Rodrigo Guimaraes, Unipartner) cover 100% of the tuition fee value. In every case 'the scholarship prize does not fund the amounts related to the application fee, the first installment of tuition paid as the enrollment fee, the CEMS program, the Double Degree program, the amount value associated with additional semesters, exchange programs, or Executive Master's programs.'
benefits: Nova SBE Merit Scholarship: 'This scholarship can cover 20 % or 50 % of the tuition fee value of the Master's program.'
Nova SBE Social Mobility Scholarship: 'This scholarship can cover 20 %, 50 %, or 100 % of the tuition fee value of the Master's program.'
Nova SBE Continuity Scholarship: 'This scholarship can cover 50 % or 100 % of the tuition fee value of the Master's program.'

Accenture, Deloitte, KPMG, NOS, Unipartner, Banco Primus, Antonio Serrenho, Andre Sousa Bessa, Explorer Excellence, McKinsey First Generation and McKinsey Women in Leadership Scholarships: 'This scholarship covers 100 % of the tuition fee value.'
NOVAFRICA Scholarship for sub-Saharan African students: 'This scholarship covers 100 %, 50 % or 20 % of the tuition fee value.'

Fixed-amount awards published on the same page: CEMS BNP Paribas Scholarship 'the yearly global amount of the scholarship is EUR 9 200'; Santander Erasmus Scholarship 'EUR 1,000 in financial support, and 6 scholarships will be awarded'; Santander Apoio Universitario 2026 'EUR 500 in financial support, and 20 scholarships will be awarded'; CFA Program Student Scholarship reduces the exam registration fee to USD 600.
eligibility: Nova SBE Merit Scholarship: 'All candidates can apply for this scholarship, regardless of their country of origin'; interest must be declared in the designated field of the master's application form.

Nova SBE Social Mobility Scholarship: 'All candidates can apply for this scholarship, regardless of their country of origin', with a proven need for financial aid evidenced by household tax documentation.

Nova SBE Continuity Scholarship: students who obtained a bachelor's degree at Nova SBE or are concluding it, admitted to any Nova SBE master's programme, 'whose per capita gross income is less than 40 times the value of the IAS'.
NOVAFRICA Scholarship: 'Outstanding students from sub-Saharan African countries who have been accepted in a Master's program at Nova SBE.'

Banco Primus Scholarship: enrolment in Economics, Impact Entrepreneurship & Innovation, Management, Finance, International Master's in Management or International Master's in Finance, 'a converted GPA equal to or above 15.5 (0-20)', eligibility for a Nova SBE Social Mobility Scholarship of 100%, and Portuguese citizenship or residence in Portugal.

Antonio Serrenho Scholarship: enrolment in named master's programmes, an application GPA above 15.0 (0-20) and Portuguese nationality, 'a preference will be given to candidates born and/or living in the Setubal area, preferably in Alcecer do Sal'.
requirements: Candidates must show interest in the scholarship during their application to the master's programme by filling in the designated area in the application form; applications 'cannot be considered after the application to the Master's program has been submitted'.
Apply within the master's admission cycle for the intended intake; the scholarship application is made 'within the same form and at the same time' as the programme application.
For need-based awards, submit the most recent household tax return properly identified, as a single PDF, covering all household members.
All documents must be in Portuguese or English, or translated by a certified translation agency or translator covering the entire document - 'partial or autonomous translations are not accepted'.

For partner-funded awards, submit in a single PDF: curriculum vitae, proof of enrolment, proof of application GPA, citizen card/passport, motivation letter and a multipurpose certificate where applicable.
To maintain an awarded merit scholarship, 'students need to check the merit criteria at the end of their first year of the Master's program'.
documents: Declaration of interest in the relevant scholarship in the designated field of the master's application form.

IRS Model 3 concerning the previous fiscal year, complete and fully identified, for every household member; candidates whose household declared income in other territories must submit a household tax return issued by a governmental or certified authority reflecting household composition, gross annual income and most recent financial situation.
Candidates in shared custody must present documentation from both legal guardians.
Certified full translation into Portuguese or English for any document issued in another language, submitted as a single PDF.

For partner-funded awards: curriculum vitae, proof of enrolment in a Nova SBE master's programme, proof of application GPA, citizen card or passport, motivation letter, multipurpose certificate when applicable, and for some awards proof of residency or naturality.

Standard master's admission documents that support the same application: English CV, official transcript with full course list and grades, one-page motivation letter in English, English proficiency certificate, and the application fee receipt.
selection_criteria: Nova SBE Merit Scholarship and Women in Finance Scholarship: 'Candidates will be ranked based on the final score resulting from the weighting of two factors: Application score; Positioning of the applicant's Bachelor's program institution in international rankings.'

Accenture and Deloitte Scholarships: 'If there are no applications meeting the disability rating, the supplementary criterion for awarding scholarships will be based on the ranking of applications with the highest GPA.'

Banco Primus Scholarship: candidates are 'selected according to their commitment, motivation, and initiative' after a three-minute English video, then 'a final interview with representatives of Banco Primus'.

Andre Sousa Bessa Scholarship: recipients of a 100% Social Mobility Scholarship 'are then selected according to their profile and community engagement', followed by 'a final interview with a representative of the Andre Sousa Bessa family'.
Explorer Excellence Scholarship: candidates are 'selected according to their determination, ambition, focus, resilience, and innovation' and 'will have a final interview with Explorer Investments'.
Rolling assessment: 'Scholarships are awarded on a rolling basis to applicants, which means that the budget available for scholarships may be used before the end of the Master's admission cycle.'
coverage: A reduction of a percentage of the master's tuition fee value - 20%, 50% or 100% depending on the award - applied as a tuition-fee reduction rather than a cash payment.

Explicit exclusions: the prize 'does not fund the amounts related to the application fee, the first installment of tuition paid as the enrollment fee, the CEMS program, the Double Degree program, the amount value associated with additional semesters, exchange programs, or Executive Master's programs'.

Cumulative cap: 'When a student is granted different scholarships within Nova SBE, the funding cannot exceed 70 % of the total amount of the tuition fee for the Master's program, except in cases where the funding comes entirely from a 100 % social mobility scholarship.' The Women in Finance Scholarship cannot be accumulated with the Nova SBE Merit Scholarship.

CEMS BNP Paribas Scholarship: 'intended to cover part of the CEMS Year 2 fee. The amount allocated can be divided between up to three students. The yearly global amount of the scholarship is EUR 9 200.'
Rodrigo Guimaraes Scholarship: 'covers 100 % of the tuition fee value and provides an allowance for the cost of living.'
Santander Erasmus Scholarship: 'EUR 1,000 in financial support' for Erasmus+ mobility, 6 scholarships awarded, applications 27 April 2026 to 26 June 2026.
application_method: Apply to the Nova SBE master's programme through the rounds-based admission process, paying the mandatory non-refundable application fee of EUR 51 per application.
Show interest in the scholarship by filling in the designated field in the master's application form.
Upload the required household income or supporting documentation in the same application, in a single PDF.
For partner-funded awards, complete the separate application form that 'will be shared with the students', usually after enrolment.
Where shortlisted, submit the requested three-minute video in English and attend a final interview with the sponsoring entity.
official.application_route: Apply to a Nova SBE master's programme and express scholarship interest inside the same application form; partner-funded awards are then applied for through a separate form shared with enrolled students.
official.citizenship_residency: The Nova SBE Merit, Social Mobility and NOVAFRICA awards are open to candidates regardless of country of origin. Many partner-funded awards instead require Portuguese nationality, or Portuguese citizenship or residence in Portugal (Banco Primus, NOS, McKinsey First Generation, McKinsey Women in Leadership), or full residence in Portuguese territory with proficiency in Portuguese and English (Unipartner).
official.international_eligibility: Yes for the core awards - the Nova SBE Merit Scholarship and Nova SBE Social Mobility Scholarship are explicitly open to all candidates regardless of country of origin, and the NOVAFRICA Scholarship exists specifically for students from sub-Saharan African countries. Most partner-funded 100% awards are, however, restricted to Portuguese nationals or residents.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Partner awards are tied to enrolment in named master's programmes (Economics, Business Analytics, Management, Finance, International Master's in Management, International Master's in Finance, Impact Entrepreneurship & Innovation, International Development and Public Policy) and to a sponsoring entity - Accenture, CIN (Antonio Serrenho), Banco Primus, Deloitte, KPMG, McKinsey, NOS, Unipartner, Explorer Investments, the Rodrigo Guimaraes Institute, CEMS Alumni, BNP Paribas Portugal, Santander, the Haddad Foundation (INSPER exchange) and the Nova SBE NOVAFRICA Knowledge Center.
official.duration: Master's regular track 1.5 years, or 2 years with an exchange semester, CEMS MIM or Double Degree (2026/2027 tuition fee tables); for each additional semester an additional fee is payable, up to three additional semesters
official.description: Nova SBE states that it offers a variety of scholarships 'covering academic merit and social mobility, ensuring that all students with potential can access a world-class education, regardless of their financial situation', awarded through an institutional portfolio together with partner-funded awards. Every award is expressed as a percentage of the master's tuition fee value and is granted on a rolling basis inside the master's admission cycle.
official.program_type: University master's tuition-fee scholarship portfolio (institutional and partner-funded)
official.english_requirement: A B2 (Upper-Intermediate) English certificate is required at application, and a minimum of C1 for the International Master's in Finance, International Master's in Management, Double Degrees and CEMS MIM. Exemptions: nationality of Antigua and Barbuda, Australia, The Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Canada, Dominica, Grenada, Guyana, Ireland, Jamaica, New Zealand, St. Kitts and Nevis, St. Lucia, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, Trinidad and Tobago, the United Kingdom or the United States of America; a bachelor's fully taught in English; a certificate of English language proficiency issued by the candidate's school of studies confirming the minimum CEFR levels; or a bachelor's completed at Nova SBE (this exemption does not apply to IMF or IMM). All language certificates should state CEFR level; basic or high-school diplomas and online language certificates other than Linguaskill and TOEFL iBT Home Edition are not accepted, and the recommended exams are Cambridge, TOEFL and IELTS. All scholarship documents must additionally be in Portuguese or English, with a certified full translation if originally written in another language.

applicant_utility.summary: Nova SBE's master's money is a tuition-percentage scheme rather than a living stipend: the Merit Scholarship is 20% or 50% of tuition and is open to any nationality, while the Social Mobility award (20/50/100%) and the Continuity award (50/100%) require full household tax documentation, and roughly a dozen partner awards pay 100% of tuition but mostly demand Portuguese nationality or residence plus eligibility for a 100% need-based award. The single most important mechanic is that you must tick the scholarship field inside the same master's application form, because scholarship interest cannot be added after submission, and awards are decided on a rolling basis so late applicants can find the budget spent. Because the awards exclude the application fee, the enrolment instalment and any CEMS, Double Degree or exchange-semester surcharge, and because none of them except the Rodrigo Guimaraes Scholarship mentions living costs, you should budget for Lisbon living expenses, the EUR 51 application fee, the EUR 1,250 or EUR 2,350 non-refundable enrolment fee and any programme add-on entirely from your own funds.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Applicants with a strong academic record of any nationality chasing the Merit or NOVAFRICA awards, and Portuguese nationals or residents with documented household need who can also qualify for the 100% partner-funded awards.
application_readiness_checklist: Open the master's application form and tick the designated scholarship field before submitting - Nova SBE states scholarship applications cannot be considered after the master's application has been submitted.

Collect the IRS Model 3, or an equivalent government-issued household tax return, for every household member for the most recent fiscal year, merged into a single PDF, and arrange a certified full translation if it is not already in Portuguese or English.

Book a B2 English certificate early, or C1 for IMF, IMM, CEMS MIM and Double Degrees; only Cambridge, TOEFL, IELTS, Linguaskill and TOEFL iBT Home Edition are accepted, and school or online-only certificates are refused.

Prepare a one-page English motivation letter, an English CV and an official transcript showing degree, final GPA and graduation date, with a Diploma Supplement if the diploma is not in English or Portuguese.

For IMF and IMM, also document at least 12 weeks of cumulative work experience or internships (volunteering does not count) and record a three-minute English motivation video hosted as an unlisted YouTube link.
Target Round 1 or Round 2 rather than Round 5, since both admission and scholarship decisions roll and the scholarship budget can be exhausted before the cycle closes.
common_rejection_risks: Missing or mismatched mandatory documents - Nova SBE excludes the application outright if any mandatory document is absent or the uploaded ID does not match the ID declared in the form, and Portuguese citizens must upload their citizen card.
Partial, self-made or uncertified translations of tax documents, which Nova SBE explicitly refuses for the need-based awards.
Trying to apply for a scholarship after the master's application has been submitted, which Nova SBE cannot consider.

Aiming for a partner award without its gateway condition, since most 100% awards require you to already be eligible for a 100% Social Mobility or Continuity scholarship, so a high GPA on its own is not enough.
Assuming awards stack freely: combined Nova SBE funding is capped at 70% of total tuition, and the Women in Finance Scholarship cannot be accumulated with the Merit Scholarship.
Applying from a t-online.de email address, which Nova SBE flags as a source of submission failures, or submitting after 5.00 pm Lisbon time so the payment falls into the next round.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: You still pay the EUR 51 application fee, the EUR 1,250 (EU/EEA) or EUR 2,350 (non-EU/EEA) non-refundable enrolment fee, the optional EUR 249 scholarship-fund donation, EUR 36.50 administrative costs, the EUR 50 master's certificate and EUR 120 diploma ('Carta de Curso') fees, and every programme add-on - EUR 8,750 for CEMS MIM, EUR 4,100 for a Double Degree, EUR 3,000 for an exchange semester, plus fees for any of up to three additional semesters. All Lisbon living costs are also on you, since no award except the Rodrigo Guimaraes Scholarship mentions a cost-of-living allowance.
document_audit: The scholarship tax file must be a single PDF covering the whole household: candidates who file their own return must also submit every other household member's return unless they prove autonomous subsistence with a declaration of honour, and shared-custody candidates need documents from both legal guardians.
Any document issued outside Portuguese or English needs a certified full translation - partial or standalone translations of extracts are rejected.
For partner awards the CV, proof of enrolment, proof of application GPA, citizen card or passport, motivation letter and multipurpose certificate must all sit in one PDF.

The uploaded identification document must be exactly the one declared in the application form, and the transcript must carry the school name, student identification and programme name to be verifiable.
alerts: The 2026/27 admission cycle is closed and 2027/28 dates are not yet published, so monitor the admission page rather than relying on last year's calendar.
Awards are rolling and the budget can be used before the end of the admission cycle - Nova SBE explicitly recommends applying as early as possible.

You may submit only one application per round to one programme; if you accept an offer from an earlier round, any later application is automatically excluded, and missing the acceptance deadline in the offer email forfeits your place.
The Merit Scholarship must be re-earned against merit criteria at the end of the first year, so it is not guaranteed for the whole programme.

Merit ranking weighs the position of your bachelor's institution in international rankings alongside your application score, so applicants from unranked universities should treat the 20% band as the realistic ceiling.
Visa processing for non-EU applicants can exceed three months after the first consulate interview, so start the process as soon as your admission is confirmed.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit one master's application per round through the Nova SBE portal with scholarship interest ticked and the single-PDF income documents attached, then the Admissions Committee scores it and scholarship results are released up to the enrolment fee (P1) deadline, after which shortlisted enrolled students run a second-stage video and interview round with the sponsoring entity.
